stories.title: New topological microscope tip reveals evidence of 2D altermagnetism
stories.desc: Researchers have fashioned a layered topological material into a scanning tunneling microscope (STM) tip that senses spin-related electronic states at atomic resolution.

stories.title: Could meditation reveal an SU(3) symmetry shared by the observer and the universe?
stories.desc: You sit down to meditate. A conversation returns, then thoughts. You bring your attention back to the breath. Sometimes, after many such returns, the effort eases. Thoughts lose their urgency, while awareness remains clear. Less occupies the mind, yet the moment still feels whole.
